definitions.explanation: A form of government in which power is concentrated in a single individual or a small group, without meaningful democratic checks. Decisions are made unilaterally without the consent of the governed.

examples.japanese: その{国|くに}は{独裁制|どくさいせい}だ。
{独裁制|どくさいせい}のもとでは{言論|げんろん}の{自由|じゆう}がない。
examples.english: Under a dictatorship, there is no freedom of speech.

examples.japanese: {市民|しみん}の{抗議|こうぎ}によって{独裁制|どくさいせい}が{崩壊|ほうかい}した。
examples.english: The dictatorship collapsed due to citizen protests.

notes:
Composed of {独裁|どくさい} (dictatorship, autocracy) + {制|せい} (system). Carries a strongly negative connotation in modern Japanese usage, implying oppressive and undemocratic governance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独裁制|どくさいせい}を{敷|し}く: to impose a dictatorship
- {独裁制|どくさいせい}が{崩壊|ほうかい}する: for a dictatorship to collapse
- {軍事|ぐんじ}{独裁制|どくさいせい}: military dictatorship
- {独裁制|どくさいせい}から{民主化|みんしゅか}: democratization from dictatorship

RELATED WORDS:
- {独裁者|どくさいしゃ}: dictator
- {君主制|くんしゅせい}: monarchy
- {民主制|みんしゅせい}: democracy (contrasting system)
- {全体主義|ぜんたいしゅぎ}: totalitarianism
